definitions.explanation: The ability to govern or control oneself according to one's own principles, without external control. Also used in technical contexts for autonomous systems or the autonomic nervous system.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{自律|じりつ}{心|しん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てたい→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧。
examples.english: I want to nurture my child's sense of self-discipline.

examples.japanese: ⟦ストレス→ストレス：03827_sutoresu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{自律|じりつ}⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乱|みだ}れている→乱れる：09506_midareru⟧。
examples.english: Stress is disrupting my autonomic nervous system.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{自律|じりつ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{働|はたら}ける→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}える→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It is important to create an environment where employees can work autonomously.

notes:
USAGE:
Distinguish from the homophone ⟦{自立|じりつ}→自立：13970_jiritsu⟧ (independence, self-reliance): {自律|じりつ} emphasizes internal self-governance and discipline ({律|りつ} = law/regulation), while ⟦{自立|じりつ}→自立：13970_jiritsu⟧ emphasizes standing on one's own feet financially or physically ({立|りつ} = stand).

{自律|じりつ}⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧ (autonomic nervous system) is a very common compound — {自律|じりつ}⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧{失調症|しっちょうしょう} (autonomic nervous system disorder) is frequently discussed in health contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自律|じりつ}⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧: autonomic nervous system
- {自律|じりつ}{心|しん}: self-discipline, autonomy
- {自律|じりつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{学習|がくしゅう}→学習：02623_gakushuu⟧: self-directed learning
- {自律|じりつ}{型|がた}⟦ロボット→ロボット：06404_robotto⟧: autonomous robot
